topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I stumbled upon a piece of paper tucked away in a drawer we rarely open. It was a list, with a title that seemed innocent enough—“My Bucket List.” My heart fluttered as I read through the neatly penciled items, some familiar, some I never imagined. I pause, my hand trembling, as I wonder if I truly know the person lying beside me every night. Each entry, a door to a world I didn’t realize existed. I feel the walls of our quiet, comfortable life shifting. The paper in my hand feels heavy, each word a weight. What do these dreams of his say about me, about us? The silence in the room is deafening.
